policy: The agent owns this slate. A topic is researched from its listed free sources, then authored and validated by the authoring pass: a ledger of verbatim sentences, narration whose every number occurs in its supporting row, and an argument map with at least five sources. A topic that fails the ledger audit stays research; nothing is rendered from an unverified storyboard.

topics.title: Jallianwala Bagh
topics.why: A single afternoon that changed the language of Indian nationalism and still shapes how the Raj is remembered.
topics.angle: The garden as a trap of architecture, orders and silence; the political aftermath rather than a body count.

topics.title: Bhopal: The Night the City Woke
topics.why: The world's worst industrial disaster is also a story about jurisdiction, corporate distance and who is allowed to be believed.
topics.angle: A city poisoned at midnight; the fight over numbers, liability and memory. No disaster-porn reconstruction.

topics.title: The Emergency: A Newspaper With a Blank Column
topics.why: A democracy suspended in the name of stability; the debate over civil liberty, federalism and memory remains live.
topics.angle: Censorship as an object: the blank space where the news should be, the prison register, the postponed election.

topics.title: Bengal 1943: The Hunger That Was Not Natural
topics.blockedReason: authoring failed 3 times: S04 did not produce five ledger-backed lines
topics.why: A famine with enough food in the country; the debate over policy, war and colonial responsibility is still contested.
topics.angle: A ration card, a rice bowl, a censored photograph and a shipping ledger. Restraint, not spectacle.

topics.title: Partition: The Line Through the House
topics.why: The largest mass migration of the twentieth century; its maps, rumours and unfinished histories still frame South Asian politics.
topics.angle: A boundary award, a train timetable, a half-packed trunk and a radio bulletin. No triumphalism, no graphic violence.
topics.blockedReason: authoring failed 3 times: the sourced storyboard did not pass the gate

topics.title: Chauri Chaura: The Fire That Stopped a Movement
topics.why: A local police-station burning forced Gandhi to halt non-cooperation; a sharp debate about discipline, violence and who owns a movement.
topics.angle: The ashes of a thana, a halted march, a telegram and the argument over whether restraint was courage or retreat.
